title: 5GMM-REGISTERED.NON-ALLOWED-SERVICE
text: The substate 5GMM-REGISTERED.NON-ALLOWED-SERVICE is chosen in the UE, if
- for 3GPP access, the cell the UE selected is known to be in a non-allowed area (see subclause5.3.5.2); or
- for wireline access, the wireline access service area restrictions are enforced
This substate is applicable only to 3GPP access and to wireline access
